name: cerrado-videos
description: Vídeos e animações da Cerrado Finanças & Tech (Remotion)

scripts.render:reel: remotion render src/index.ts Reel4Frentes out/reel-4-frentes.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:intro: remotion render src/index.ts FolinhaIntro out/folinha-intro.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:gif: remotion render src/index.ts FolinhaLoopGif out/folinha-loop.gif --codec gif --every-nth-frame 2
scripts.render:alpha: remotion render src/index.ts FolinhaLoopAlpha out/folinha-loop.webm --codec vp8 --image-format png --pixel-format yuva420p
scripts.render:software: remotion render src/index.ts ReelSoftware out/reel-software.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:contabilidade: remotion render src/index.ts ReelContabilidade out/reel-contabilidade.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:credito: remotion render src/index.ts ReelCredito out/reel-credito.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:cursos: remotion render src/index.ts ReelCursos out/reel-cursos.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:frentes: npm run render:software && npm run render:contabilidade && npm run render:credito && npm run render:cursos
scripts.render:ia-na-pratica: remotion render src/index.ts ReelIaNaPratica out/reel-ia-na-pratica.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:ia-farma: remotion render src/index.ts ReelIaFarma out/reel-ia-farma.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:cursos-cerraclass: npm run render:ia-na-pratica && npm run render:ia-farma
